build_ProposalModule: build a ProposalModule for 3D object detection with vote aggregation and proposal generation
run_ProposalModule_forward: run the ProposalModule forward pass with xyz coordinates and features to generate object proposals
decode_scores: decode raw network output into objectness scores, center, heading, size, and semantic class scores
create_vote_aggregation: create a PointnetSAModuleVotes for aggregating votes around sampled proposals with configurable radius and sample count
test_ProposalModule_sampling: test the ProposalModule with vote_fps, seed_fps, or random sampling strategies on point cloud votes
